restartQuestion: Start this stop again? This round’s answers will reset.
mapQuestion: Go to the town map? Your saved scores stay here. This round will start again.
duck: Lower music while the voice talks
quietNote: Library / Class mode keeps voice and music off. Sound effects are low.
words: Light up each word as it is read
wasdNav: Arrow keys and WASD move between buttons
calmSystem: Calm motion is on in this device’s settings.
findCards: Show a card for each find
noTimers: Take your time. This game has no timers.
voicePackSoon: Offline voice downloads are available in For grown-ups when supported.
reserved: That key is kept for your browser. Pick another key.
badgeLocked: Keep exploring to earn this badge.
noSaves: No saved games yet. Choose New game to start.
deleteQuestion: To delete this player’s saved game, choose Turtle. Other players keep their games.
allSlots: All animal slots are in use. Choose a saved game, or delete one.
slotsNextPerson: A different person? Start the next player so their notes, player code and score sharing start fresh.
saveFailed: This browser cannot save your progress. Ask a grown-up, or keep this tab open.
badgeHint.three-stars: Earn three stars on any stop.
badgeHint.try-again: Replay a stop and beat your own best.
badgeHint.all-ears: Listen to every neighbor in Stop 3.
badgeHint.source-checker: Open every source in a Stop 4 round.
badgeHint.good-question: Build four clear questions in Stop 2.
badgeHint.sign-spotter: Find every sign without extra taps in Stop 1.
badgeHint.quiet-pro: Finish a stop in quiet mode.
badgeHint.process-5: Finish Stop 5 by exploring what could change.
badgeHint.process-6: Finish Stop 6 by checking who decides.
badgeHint.process-7: Finish Stop 7 by practicing a kind message.
badgeHint.process-8: Finish Stop 8 by listening during a disagreement.
badgeHint.process-9: Finish Stop 9 by inviting missing voices.
badgeHint.process-10: Finish Stop 10 by comparing possible fixes.
badgeHint.process-12: Finish Stop 12 by building a fair deal.
badgeHint.process-13: Finish Stop 13 by checking a message's source.
badgeHint.process-15: Finish Stop 15 by making a shared plan.
openGameFailed: The game could not open. Your saved progress is still here. Try opening it again.
progressNote: Save a file with the saved games on this device: scores, badges and a short list of recent game steps. It has no names, and the game never sends it anywhere. Open it on this device or another one to keep going.
progressSaved: Progress file saved. Keep it somewhere safe.
progressSaveFailed: The progress file could not be saved. Try again.
progressOpened: Progress file opened. Its games are on this device now.
progressFull: Progress file opened, but some games did not fit. This device already has eight saved games.
progressUnsaved: Progress file opened for now, but this browser cannot save it. Keep this tab open to play these games.
progressNothing: No games from this progress file were added, so nothing changed. It may have no saved games, or this device already has eight.
progressInvalid: This is not a Pecan Grove progress file, or it is damaged. Nothing changed.
progressNewer: This progress file is from a newer version of the game. Nothing changed.
